page.overview:
Who is Axle Accelerator?

"Badge #153, Axle Accelerator, may be the fastest hot-pursuit vehicle on the force, but he's also the first to volunteer for escort duty when it comes to his favorite Piston Cup champions! No matter how cushy the job, he's always on the ready to break into the next high speed chase."
